note: Source of truth for hand-deployed Lambdas (no CI). $LATEST = the dev alias for every function; staging/prod ride PUBLISHED versions. Pull-live before editing; deploy updates $LATEST (dev) only.

functions.name: ZoooomOfferNotification
functions.purpose: Inbox + SES notifier. Direct {eventType} dispatch: OFFER_*/PAYMENT_*/SALE_*/CONFIRM_SALE_REQUEST/LISTING_WITHDRAWN/SERVICE_REMINDER. Per-env via alias qualifier.

functions.name: ZoooomServiceReminder
functions.purpose: Daily maintenance sweep + ad-hoc {vin,userId}. QUALIFIER-BASED (resolves _dev/_staging/_prod + same-env ZoooomOfferNotification alias from invoked qualifier). One version serves all envs.

functions.name: ZoooomAddServiceRecord
functions.purpose: Scanned service-record add (+dedup). On success invokes SERVICE_REMINDER_FN {vin,userId} for instant schedule refresh.

functions.name: ZoooomAddServiceRecordManual
functions.purpose: Manual service-record add. On success invokes SERVICE_REMINDER_FN {vin,userId}.

functions.name: ZoooomDealOffer
functions.purpose: Deal/offer CRUD (POST /offers, /deals, GET /deals/{id}/offers, accept/counter/decline). putDeal strips empty GSI-key attrs (vin/sellerId/buyerId) so empty-vin offers don't 500 on VinIndex.

functions.name: ZoooomMessagingV3
functions.purpose: Inbox/chat + notification prefs. set_prefs/get_prefs write/read notificationPreferences on ZoooomUser (composite IdUser+email). Origin allowlist enforced.

functions.name: ZoooomDailyStats
functions.purpose: Daily prod metrics digest to Slack: signups, returning logins, reports run, AI inspections, garage adds, listings, offers made/accepted, cars sold. Each as yesterday / 7d rolling / WoW. PT day buckets. PROD-ONLY (no env switch by design): _prod tables + :Prod alias filters on logs and CloudWatch. Invoke {dryRun:true} to preview without posting.

functions.name: ZoooomAddVehicleDynamoDB
functions.purpose: Adds/re-lists a vehicle in the user's garage. Writes createdAt/updatedAt (new add + archived re-add); active re-list PRESERVES createdAt. ZoooomDailyStats counts garage adds off createdAt.
functions.warning: ENV VARS ARE BAKED INTO PUBLISHED VERSIONS. Never publish from $LATEST and point Prod at it — that ships DEV table names to prod. Promote by: set $LATEST env to target-env values -> publish -> move alias -> restore $LATEST to dev. Code defaults in index.mjs are _prod (NOT dev-safe) so a missing env var silently hits prod.

functions.name: ZoooomGetMarketValue
functions.purpose: Market value by VIN (VehicleDatabases). MMYT cost cache; falls back to VIN-scoped cache + background VIN decode when ZoooomVinLookup has no row. Per-env via alias + VEHICLE_TABLE.

functions.name: ZoooomMechanicSignupNotify

aliases.dev: $LATEST (no staging/prod aliases by design — one version serves all envs)

functions.streams: ZoooomMechanicUser_{dev,staging,prod} -> unqualified fn (INSERT only). ESM startingPosition LATEST, batch 10, retries 2.
functions.iam: basic-user-role inline policy ZoooomMechanicSignupStreams (stream read on the 3 mechanic-user tables).
functions.purpose: Announces new mechanic signups in Slack #new-mechanics. STREAM-BASED so neither ZoooomAddMechanicUser nor ZoooomAddMasterMechanicUser had to be touched (both live + on the parity allow-list) and a Slack outage can never fail a signup. Env resolved FROM THE STREAM ARN, so one version serves all three envs and the wrong table can never reach the wrong channel; only prod has a channel configured. Dedups redeliveries via slackSignupTs on the user row. Enriches with shop name (master/legacy table) + role/status (junction table, one 2.5s retry since the link row is written just after the user row).

functions.name: ZoooomAuditTrail
functions.role: ZoooomAuditWriterRole (NOT basic-user-role) — stream read + PutItem on ZoooomAudit_{env} only.

aliases.dev: $LATEST (no staging/prod aliases by design — env comes from the stream ARN)

functions.streams: 20 in-scope business tables x 3 envs = 60 ESMs -> unqualified fn. LATEST, batch 25, window 5s, retries 5, bisectBatchOnFunctionError, onFailure -> SQS ZoooomAuditDLQ.

env.MAX_IMAGE_BYTES: 120000 — above this, row images are dropped and only changed field names/values are kept so the item can never be rejected for size
env.AUDIT_TABLE_OVERRIDE: unset (normally ZoooomAudit_{env} from the stream ARN)

functions.purpose: Append-only 'who changed what, when' trail. Replaces the never-functional ZoooomInternalUserActionAuditLog (0 rows ever, unreachable, dev table in all envs, body-supplied actor). Stream-based so coverage is structural, not a discipline. Records action/before/after/changedFields; actor read ONLY from a stamped field for that action class (createdBy on CREATE, updatedBy|lastUpdatedBy|approvedBy|reviewedBy on UPDATE, deletedBy on DELETE) — never cross-falls-back, so unstamped writes read 'unknown' instead of being misattributed to the creator. Sensitive fields redacted. Fails CLOSED (throws -> retries -> DLQ). Immutability enforced in IAM + PITR + deletion protection, verified by lib/audit-coverage.sh.
functions.known_gaps: (1) Hard DELETEs are unattributable unless deletedBy is stamped first — prefer soft-delete/archive. (2) Actor attribution is only as good as the writers: prod is ~92% actorId=unknown until the in-scope mutators stamp an actor. (3) BLOCKER: ZoooomInternalUserAPI{,Staging,Prod} have 84/84 methods with authorizationType NONE, so no verifiable claim exists for internal staff writes — attach a Cognito authorizer before stamping actors there.

functions.name: ZoooomInternalInbox
functions.routes: GET/POST /internal-inbox on all 3 internal APIs, behind ZoooomInternalStaffAuth. OPTIONS=MOCK/NONE for CORS.

env.STAFF_POOL_ID: Cognito internal pool for THIS env

functions.purpose: The inbox belonging to INTERNAL STAFF — distinct from ZoooomInternalGetUserInbox, which reads a CONSUMER's inbox (ZoooomUserInbox_{env}) for a customer id in the request. Actions: list / markRead / markUnread / broadcast / sweepMissedChats. A support chat that escalated to a human and got no 'agent' reply within MISSED_AFTER_MINUTES is broadcast to EVERY staff inbox. Roster comes from the Cognito staff pool, NOT ZoooomInternalUser_{env} (prod holds 0 rows while the prod pool has 2 real staff, so table-based fan-out would reach nobody). Idempotent: deterministic messageId (missed-chat#<conversationId>#<lastUserMsgId>) + byMessage index check, so the 15-min schedule can never double-post. Identity comes ONLY from the verified Cognito claim; no claim => 401. Support-email (Gmail) ingestion is intentionally NOT built — broadcast is the seam for it.

functions.name: ZoooomInternalGetMechanic

env.VITE_AWS_MECHANIC_TABLE: ZoooomMechanic_{env} — DEAD on current code, read only by pre-v3/v4 versions

functions.purpose: Staff mechanic list. Promoted 2026-07-29 so all envs read ZoooomMasterMechanic_{env} (was legacy ZoooomMechanic_{env} on staging/prod). Legacy mechanics are CHILDREN of a master: master is keyed on the Google place/address, while scanned service records can misread mechanic details and create many near-duplicate legacy rows. The master's linkedLegacyMechanics array is the drill-down. KNOWN DATA GAPS: prod stores those entries as plain STRINGS while dev stores OBJECTS; prod linkedRecordsCount disagrees with the array; and linkedToMasterId is unpopulated on legacy rows in ALL envs, so legacy->master navigation does not work.

functions.name: ZoooomMechanicRewards
functions.purpose: Mechanic rewards + referral API. ensure-code / claim-signup-bonus / record-verification / request-redemption. QUALIFIER-BASED: tables AND the referral base URL derive from the invoked alias, so one published version is correct in all 3 envs. Deterministic rewardIds under attribute_not_exists prevent double-pay.

functions.name: ZoooomMechanicReferralTrack
functions.purpose: Consumer-side attribution. attribute / qualify / lookup. A consumer counts ONCE (conditional flip on the attribution row); the referral row's qualifiedCount is an atomic ADD, so the every-5th $10 milestone fires exactly once under concurrency.

functions.name: ZoooomMechanicSite
functions.purpose: Public read-only resolver for published shop pages (/[slug]). Allow-listed projection; refuses unpublished records by slug (owner preview goes via masterMechanicId). Scan is paginated + edge-cached; add a GSI on `slug` when published shops reach the hundreds.

functions.name: ZoooomMechanicRewardNotify

aliases.dev: $LATEST (no staging/prod aliases by design — one version serves all envs)

functions.streams: ZoooomMechanicReward_{dev,staging,prod} -> unqualified fn (INSERT + MODIFY). ESM startingPosition LATEST, batch 10, retries 2.
functions.purpose: GIFT CARDS ARE ISSUED BY HAND — this is the only thing that tells anyone money is owed. Announces PENDING_ISSUE inserts, redemption requests, and HELD->PENDING_ISSUE releases (how banked $25 verifications reach the channel when financing launches). Per-kind dedup stamps survive stream redelivery.

functions.name: ZoooomMechanicVerificationUpload
functions.bundledDeps: @aws-sdk/client-s3 + @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner are NOT in the nodejs22 runtime — vendored in node_modules, so this function ships a ~3MB zip.
functions.storage: zoooom-deal-verification-{env}, SSE-KMS alias/zv-dealverify-{env}. Provisioned by lib/create-deal-verification-buckets.sh.
functions.purpose: Presigned PUT (5 min, PUT-only) for deal-verification captures: buyer/seller photos + BOTH driver's licence scans + title scan. IDENTITY-DOCUMENT data class. AUTH IS MANDATORY here (401 without a token) unlike the sibling mechanic routes — it hands out write access to an ID bucket. ⚠️ Token is NOT signature-verified (no Cognito authorizer on this gateway); acceptable ONLY because the URL is PUT-only, the key is built server-side from the caller's sub, content type is allow-listed, and TTL is 5 min. FOLLOW-UP: add a real Cognito authorizer; do not relax those constraints before then.
functions.iam: Managed policy ZoooomDealVerificationUpload (inline budget on basic-user-role is FULL). PutObject only — no Get/Delete/List.
